asr.full_text: So, hey friends, this is Atif for Purewell and welcome to the new update on Stellarcoin. In the last video, I discussed about this possible Cypher move and for some people it would be hypothetical or maybe too early to be discussed about this move. However, we should keep an discussed about this move however we should keep an eye on this move and it is possible that the price line will complete this cypher move however there are different supports before this potential reversal zone we need those supports to be broken down for the completion of this final leg and in today's video i'm going to show you those supports and how this move can be confirmed so first of all i want to show you this move we have already seen in my previous videos that on the daily time frame chart the price line i completed this bull flag and after the formation of this bull flag the price line also formed this down channel you can see and after break out the price line even crossed the next resistance of 40 cents and reached up to 60 cents and now it is moving down and at this time it is at the support of ema 10 and we also have the ema 21 at the same level where we have this 40 cents support level. That was working as a resistance previously. Now it will be working as a support. And if I place this Fibonacci tool from this low to this high, then we can see that so far the price line has been retraced between 0.382 to 0.50 Fibonacci retracement level and in order to retrace up to this Golden ratio the priceline need to retest the ema21 as well like previously the price action after this rally was retraced between 0.618 to 0.786 fibonacci retracement level uh approximately at the golden ratio of the fibonacci retracement now if we the golden ratio of the Fibonacci retracement. Now, if we switch to the small time period for our chart, then here we can see that the price line has found this short term support level at 47 cents. Then we have this 40 cent support that can be also seen on this daily chart as well. Then we have this 30 cents resistant support level and here this is the the very important move that i want to show you that the price line has found this very important rejection line or resistance line and i have just copied this resistance line and paste it here then we can see that the price line has formed this up channel and after getting rejected the price line is moving at this at the support of this up channel and from here it is getting bounced moving down and after taking bounce it is moving uh towards the resistance and after being rejected at this time you can see that the price line has been clearly rejected by this resistance again. So it is possible that the price line may move down up to this support and if it will be moved like in this angle, sense and here i have also placed this rsi indicator as well the oscillator and we can see that whenever the price line was reached at this resistance of this channel the rsi was also entered in the over bar zone and after that the price action this rsi entered back in the body and you can see that the candlesticks also reached at the support and here you can see the the rsi has repeated this act here and now at this time this is for the third time we can see that the rsi was entered in this overbought zone and with this move of the rsi the price action also reached at the resistance and now it is again rejected by the resistance and we can see that the RSI is again moving down if I replace the RSI with the Stochastic indicator and we can see that from the overbought zone the Stochastic has given bear cross this is a very strong bearish signal on this daily time frame chart that the price action has reached at the resistance of the subchannel and the stochastic indicator or oscillator has given us the sell signal. Now for the completion of this cipher move because there are two possibilities that number one is that the price action will reach up to this support of the sub channel and from here it will move to the upside and again it will form another higher high like it is forming forming the higher highs uh but the next possibility will be if the price line will break down the support of the sub channel then it can compete this cipher move. That's hard from point six and eight fibonacci retracement level and ends up to .7. eight six per minute retracement level. So in order to complete this final leg of this cipher move, the Priceline needs to break some certain supports like, for example, sub. First of all, the Priceline needs to brig and break down this EM example sub first of all the price line needs to break breakdown this ea at 10 on the daily time frame chart then ea 21 then finally the Priceline also needs to break down the support of the channel and this 40-cent support level as well so after breaking down this support, of this up channel, we will have the closing below this support, and we can be confirmed that this CFR move will be completed. So, in next situation, like in first situation, in first possibility we can understand that the price line can be bounced from here like it false balanced previously or after breaking down in the second situation there is another bullish reversal move we can expect that the price line will enter in this potential reversal zone of the cypher move and from here it will turn bullish i will also share this move at the cypher move at the patreon as well so far i'm just waiting for uh the price line to reach up to this support if it will reach up to this support after breaking down these two support levels that ema 10 and email 21 uh then i will also share the complete buying and sale targets at the patreon and if you would like to support me at the patreon then you can follow the link i've shared in the videos description and in this potential reversal zone of this cipher move we can see this is the simple moving average with the time period of 100 and this is 200 simple moving average so we have very strong supports within this potential reversal zone the 100 and 200 simple moving averages but i i don't want to create any panic but we should keep an eye on this move it is also possible because every time the price line is rejected by this rejection line or this resistance of this up channel it is at least moving up to this support of the channels but it is also possible that the price line will be moved up from here by using this ema10 or ema21 as a support and this up channel will be changed to this rising wedge pattern like if we will have the higher high like we have sorry the higher low like we had here like we had here and if we would have another low here somewhere then the pattern will be changed from this up channel to this rising wedge pattern like i'm showing at this time uh however at this time uh we have received the berry signals and you can see that the price line is also rejected like once again by this resistance line so this was the update so far i hope that you have liked the video then do hit the like and do subscribe to the channel as well and if i will have more updates i will definitely share with you on the daily basis especially about the stellar coin
